edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with admin to gate owner change in changeOwner.
msg.sender is compared with admin to gate admin change in changeAdmin.
msg.sender is assigned as owner during AdminVault construction.
onlyAdmin modifier checks msg.sender before allowing selfdestruct in kill.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before withdrawing funds.
msg.sender is passed into the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is passed into the onlyAdmin modifier.
onlyOwner modifier guards withdrawStuckFunds execution.
onlyAdmin modifier guards kill execution.
block.timestamp is written to changeStartTime in startContractChange (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp compared against wait period in approveContractChange (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is written to changeStartTime in startWaitPeriodChange (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp compared against wait period in approveWaitPeriodChange (timestamp dependency).
onlyOwner gates addNewContract via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates revertToPreviousAddress via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates approveContractChange via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates cancelContractChange via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates startWaitPeriodChange via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates approveWaitPeriodChange via msg.sender check.
onlyOwner gates cancelWaitPeriodChange via msg.sender check.
msg.sender is passed as src into isAuthorized by the auth modifier.
isAuthorized compares src against the owner state variable.
isAuthorized delegates the decision to authority.canCall.
setOwner writes the owner state variable.
setAuthority writes the authority state variable.
kill reaches the selfdestruct unsafe operation.
withdrawStuckFunds performs an ETH transfer to an attacker-controlled receiver, enabling reentrancy.
sendValue performs a low-level value call to the recipient, enabling reentrancy.
_functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target.
functionCall delegates execution to _functionCallWithValue.
DSProxy.execute forwards arbitrary calldata to a target that can re-enter the proxy.
DSProxyCache.write deploys code through inline-assembly CREATE.
DSProxyCache.write stores the deployed address in the cache mapping.
setCache writes the cache address when the caller is authorized, affecting proxy targets.
isTriggered calls getRatio to compute the vault ratio.
isTriggered calls shouldTrigger to evaluate threshold comparisons.
isTriggered makes an external call to the MCD price verifier.
isTriggered decodes the call data into CallParams.
isTriggered decodes the sub data into SubParams.
getRatio calls getCdpInfo to obtain collateral and debt.
getRatio calls getPrice when no next price is supplied.
getAddr reads the contract address from the entries mapping.
addNewContract writes the new entry into the entries mapping.
approveContractChange reads pendingAddresses to swap the contract address.
revertToPreviousAddress reads previousAddresses for rollback.
approveWaitPeriodChange reads pendingWaitTimes for the new wait period.
checkedRatio result is compared to the threshold inside shouldTrigger.
collateral is multiplied by price via wmul inside getRatio.
debt is multiplied by rate and divided in rdiv inside getRatio.
nextPrice is divided by 1e9 inside isTriggered, a precision-sensitive scaling.
vaultId is used to fetch ilk and CDP info in getRatio.
ilk is used as key when reading vat.urns and vat.ilks.
_owner argument is assigned into the owner state variable.
_admin argument is assigned into the admin state variable.
_receiver argument is the destination of the fund transfer.
_amount argument is the transferred amount.
_token argument selects the ETH or ERC20 withdrawal branch.
_id argument keys the entries mapping in addNewContract.
_contractAddr argument is stored in the new registry entry.
_newContractAddr argument is stored in pendingAddresses.
oldContractAddr local is stored into previousAddresses.
target argument is the destination of the low-level call.
data argument is forwarded as calldata to the target.
weiValue argument is attached to the low-level call.
_code argument is used to deploy a contract and compute its hash.
target local is the address returned by inline-assembly create.
_callData is abi.decoded into CallParams inside isTriggered.
_subData is abi.decoded into SubParams inside isTriggered.
shouldTriggerCurr flag is returned by isTriggered.
shouldTriggerNext flag is returned by isTriggered.
verification result gates the revert inside isTriggered.

_token is a parameter used only by withdrawStuckFunds; fold into that function node.

_vaultId is the vault parameter of getRatio; fold into getRatio.
_nextPrice is the price parameter of getRatio; fold into getRatio.

debt is a local returned by getCdpInfo; fold into getCdpInfo.
